content: Meera Chauhan followed up on an earlier call regarding her expired auto policy (Policy Number: DC-001234), seeking clarification on the expiration and steps for reinstatement. Anjali Desai replied, explaining that Meera needs to pay the outstanding premium and provide proof of continuous insurance, and provided a reinstatement form and payment link.

action_items: Pay the outstanding premium using the provided payment link
Fill out and submit the attached reinstatement form
